notes.title: Feed the School! is Coming to Steam – Wishlist Now!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41750931/a44f67c55de7d52661f60d44281c9ac40aa78daf.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]I’m super excited to announce my new project: [b]Feed the School![/b]
It’s a chaotic spin-off of [b]Bash the Teacher![/b], and the Steam page is now live — [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930280/Feed_the_School_Chili_Chaos/"]you can wishlist it here![/url][/p][p]In [b]Feed the School![/b], the mayhem moves from the classroom to the cafeteria. Get ready to stir up trouble... literally. 🔥[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Game Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Chaotic Cooking Fun[/b][/p][p]Juggle cooking, plating, and serving in a fast-paced school kitchen that’ll keep your adrenaline sizzling.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Turn Up the Heat[/b][/p][p]Drop flaming hot chili peppers into the teachers’ meals—then stand back and enjoy the fireworks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Satisfying Gameplay Loop[/b][/p][p]Cook, serve, prank, upgrade—and repeat. Every lunchtime gets spicier, sillier, and more addictive.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Featuring Familiar Faces:[/b][/h3][p]Yep — your favourite (or least favourite) teachers are back for seconds. Only this time, they’re hungry... and [i]you’re [/i]running the kitchen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why Wishlist?[/b][/h3][p]Wishlisting really helps! It boosts visibility and puts the game in front of more players.[/p][p]If you had fun with [b]Bash the Teacher![/b], you're going to love this spicy new twist.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930280/Feed_the_School_Chili_Chaos/"]Click here to wishlist Feed the School! now [/url]👈[/p][p]Thanks so much for all your support — I can’t wait to show you more![/p]

notes.title: New Content Released
notes.notes:
[h1]New content released:[/h1]

- 2 new teachers.
- 8 new weapon upgrades.
- 8 new pet upgrades.
- 8 new desk item upgrades.
- New points system: upgrades now increase stars earned from bashing.
- 38 new Steam achievements.

notes.title: New Content Coming Soon...
notes.notes:
I’d just like to say a big thank you to all that have checked out ‘Bash the Teacher!’ so far!

Additional content will be coming soon…
New content will include 2 brand new teachers to bash, more weapon upgrades, pet upgrades & desk item upgrades! Plus of course there will be a load more steam achievements to keep you busy!
